Creates a CASH reservation for property AMS01, room 101 (SMALL); CASH is confirmed immediately. Saves reservationId to the environment for later requests.

Creates a BANK_TRANSFER reservation for property AMS01, room 201 (MEDIUM): PENDING_PAYMENT with a payment deadline and bank transfer instructions. Saves reservationId to the environment for later requests.

Creates a CREDIT_CARD reservation for AMS01 room 202 (MEDIUM). The reservation service first asks credit-card-payment-service for the status of paymentReference OK-123 (stub: prefix OK → CONFIRMED), then stores it CONFIRMED. Saves reservationId. Re-running it gives 409 PAYMENT_REFERENCE_ALREADY_USED (one card payment backs one reservation), without calling the payment service; change paymentReference (e.g. OK-124) and the dates to book again.
Stub prefix REJ → REJECTED, so the reservation service answers 422 PAYMENT_REJECTED and stores nothing (repeatable).

Always 503 PAYMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After: 5, and never books anything. With the stub running, the SLOW prefix makes it answer after 5 s, past our 2 s read timeout: three attempts, about 6.5 s. With the stub stopped (`docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop credit-card-payment-service`), the connection fails and the answer comes in about 2-3 s. Repeat it a few times and the circuit breaker opens: the answer is then immediate, without any call. Start the stub again afterwards.

item.name: credit-card-payment-service
item.description: The stub implementing the corrected credit-card spec (credit-card-payment-service/src/main/resources/openapi/credit-card-payment-api.yaml). No auth (the spec declares none, ADR-0011). Behaviour by reference prefix: OK → CONFIRMED, REJ → REJECTED, SLOW → 5 s then CONFIRMED, ERR → 500, anything else → 404.

request.description: Calls the stub directly. Change the reference prefix to see the other outcomes.
